subject: Capacity sweep: Tungsten Syndicate — provisional hold & mutual action plan
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-17T15:23:00-07:00
Subject: Capacity sweep: Tungsten Syndicate — provisional hold & mutual action plan

Hi team,

Tungsten Syndicate is moving fast — we got verbal confirmation from Amara that legal/procurement will need the final SOW + PO by the end of April to hit a May 15 start. Before I loop them with a formal mutual action plan, can we run a quick internal availability check and, if feasible, place a soft hold on capacity? Key asks below: 

- Expected initial dedicated sizing: approx. 8–10 GPU-equivalents (A100 -> H100 mix), sustained for first 6 months with a 3x token/batch ramp.
- Preferred region: us-west-2; flexible within US if capacity is tight.
- Target provisioning window: 2028-05-15 (soft start), production by 2028-05-29.

Attachments: deal_summary_tungsten.pdf, initial_estimate.csv (high-level numbers).

Please run a fleet scan and tell me:
1) Can we reserve the required capacity for the proposed window?
2) Recommended hold type (soft hold / provisional reservation / committed allocation) and any lead-time caveats.
3) Risks to other late-stage deals if we reserve (brief).

I need a one-page ops note + proposed ticket to preserve capacity by end of day so I can communicate a definitive ask to Amara tomorrow.

Thanks —
Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0132
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-17T17:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity sweep: Tungsten Syndicate — provisional hold & mutual action plan

Ben / Laura —

Quick fleet scan complete. Summary:

- Availability: We have capacity in us-west-2 but not contiguous 10x H100-80 nodes; we can satisfy the equivalent using a mix of 6x H100-80 + 8x A100-80 pooled behind our GPU multiplexing layer with minor perf adjustments.
- Lead time: reprovisioning and live migration for contiguous dedicated pools will take ~7 business days.
- Recommendation: create a provisional "standby" reservation (internal hold) that pins the requested compute for the May 15 window. This should be convertible to committed allocation once PO arrives.

Proposed mitigation details:
- Hold type: provisional_hold (non-billing, reserve token capacity).
- Internal ticket: CH-8241 (created - pending approval).
- Expected impact: <10% throughput degradation for Elastic customers in us-west-2 during the hold period if we do not spin extra burst capacity; alternative is a short-term burst allocation (cost delta estimated in attachment).

Action items for you:
- Approve provisional_hold so I can escalate to capacity ops and mark the pool.
- If approved, confirm whether we want to earmark H100-only or allow heterogenous mix. Given their latency needs, I recommend H100-primary with A100 fallback.

Attachment: capacity_scan_20280417.xlsx (contains node lists, existing reservations, and cost delta table).

Karthik
Principal Infra Planner, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Amara Solis <amara.solis@tungstensyndicate.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-17T18:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Final SOW and capacity window for Tungsten Syndicate

Amara —

Thanks again for the conversation today. Two quick items that will get us to a smooth launch:

1) Redwood can provisionally reserve the GPUs needed for your initial deployment pending a signed PO. Karthik ran a quick scan and recommends a provisional_hold (non-billing) that we convert to a committed allocation once your PO clears.

2) Mutual action plan (high-level):
   - Apr 18: Redwood places provisional_hold on capacity (pending).
   - Apr 30: Customer PO executed / signature completed (DocuSign link below).
   - May 15: Soft start (integration & staging).
   - May 29: Production launch.

I attached the SOW (SOW_v3.pdf) for your review and included a DocuSign link for signature: https://www.docusign.com/links/TS-SOW-v3

Karthik notes that the provisional hold has minimal operational impact but we need confirmation on whether you prefer H100-primary or are fine with a mixed H100/A100 pool. If you can confirm that preference in your PO or reply here, we will lock the exact profile.

If you want me to raise the DocuSign to procurement directly, I can.

Best,
Ben
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
